body:
mike: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service 'billing-ingest' but PD shows the alert targeted 'platform-oncall' in the payload. I think this is a schedule binding issue after last night's timezone sync.

pagerduty-bot: [Alert] High error-rate on /v1/infer (billing-ingest) — triggered 1767601229. Escalation policy: default-oncall -> platform-oncall.

schedule-syncer: automated message: completed nightly sync at 2026-03-15T02:00:12Z, applied 34 schedule updates. (log id: sync-1767600000)

alyssa: I just got paged. I'm on platform-oncall, not billing. I don't have access to the billing runbooks. Is billing the correct service?

mike: No — alert source indicates model-serving for billing customers, but the PD service field is wrong. Looks like syncer flipped service-tags for the night schedules.

sarah: customer impact? Do we know if requests are failing or slow?

mike: Cloud metrics show 5xx spikes from billing inference nodes ~02:00 -> 02:10 UTC. Some customers reported elevated latencies, but no 100% outage.

jordan: Paging details from PD payload: ``service: platform-oncall, incident_key: 0123abcd, routing_key: RK_PLATFORM``. Original alert rule referenced service id: billing-ingest (svc-BILL-77). The schedule-syncer job maps tags -> PD bindings; suspect the tag -> service mapping got duplicated.

alyssa: I can ack but I don't have the ops creds to do node checks. If this is billing, we should re-route to billing-oncall.

mike: Please don't ack until we confirm — we want the billing team to get primary page. If acked here PD will escalate incorrectly and create noise.

pagerduty-bot: Incident 12345 assigned to platform-oncall (ack by alyssa) — escalation timer paused.

alyssa: acked because I couldn't get PD to re-route. Sorry, thought it was transient.

mike: that's fine, thanks. Can someone with PD admin run the rebind? We need to change the incident service and reassign to billing-oncall, then trigger a new page.

jordan: Running rebind now — will create a new incident for billing and link. Command: ```pagerduty-cli incidents change-service --incident 12345 --service svc-BILL-77 --note "rebind due to schedule-syncer duplicate tag"```

(schedule-syncer): log excerpt: ``2026-03-15T01:59:58Z INFO applying tag-binding: nightly-ops -> svc-BILL-77``
(schedule-syncer): log excerpt: ``2026-03-15T02:00:05Z WARN detected duplicate tag mapping for 'nightly-ops' (existing: svc-PLAT-11)``

jordan: rebind command ran, PD created incident 12346 for billing-oncall and sent a page. Billing acknowledged 12346. New incident link: https://pd.example.com/incidents/12346

mike: Thanks. Can someone suppress the original alert noise while we fix the source? If schedule-syncer retries nightly it will keep flipping things.

sarah: Assigning follow-up: oncall -> infra to patch syncer mapping and add a safety check for duplicate bindings during DST changes.

alyssa: Quick mitigation note for others: if you get paged and it looks like the wrong service, ping #incidents and do not ack unless you can take ownership. Use the PD 'change-service' flow instead.

jordan: Root cause so far: schedule-syncer applied overlapping timezone adjustments for schedules when the org timezone conversion code hit a previously unseen DST edge case. Duplicate binding created: 'nightly-ops' pointed at both svc-PLAT-11 and svc-BILL-77; PD chose platform in the incident payload.

mike: Customer impact summary: ~7 customers experienced increased latency (median +800ms) for inference on billing-specific endpoints between 02:00-02:12 UTC. No data loss. Billing team confirmed degradation on two hosts that hit rate limits and returned 5xx temporarily.

sarah: Action items: [1] infra to add dedupe-check in schedule-syncer (owner: jordan) [2] PD admin to add a pre-flight validation step to avoid publishing when duplicate tag bindings exist (owner: mike) [3] run reconciliation job to detect and fix any other overlapping mappings today (owner: jordan) [4] postmortem + customer comms draft (owner: sarah).

jordan: I pushed a quick guard: don't apply updates if duplicate tags found; syncer now exits with non-zero and alerts SRE on deploy. Patch deployed to staging, running reconciliation now.

mike: Reconciliation found 3 other tags with dual bindings; fixed and re-ran PD mapping.

sarah: I'll start a short customer-facing note summarizing impact and remediation.

alyssa: Thanks all. Two operational notes: add a test case for DST boundary to CI; and please add a PD runbook snippet for 'change-service' steps to make reassignments safe.

jordan: Will add tests and runbook PRs.

pagerduty-bot: Incident 12346 (billing-oncall) resolved by billing team at 1767601750. Incident 12345 (platform-oncall) auto-resolved by PD after rebind at 1767601785.

mike: Closing here — postmortem assigned to sarah, due EOD tomorrow. If anyone wants to add logs or notes, paste them below.

sarah: I'll start the postmortem doc and link it when ready.

alyssa: marking follow-up in my checklist. :white_check_mark:

mike: TL;DR — wrong service paged due to schedule-syncer duplicate tag mapping during timezone/DST edge case. Mitigated by rebind and reconciliation. Owners and follow-ups assigned.
